parole.significato: A non-Inuit person in Canada or Greenland, especially a European or someone of European descent.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Eastern Canadian Inuktitut ᖃᓪᓗᓈᖅ (qallunaaq, “foreigner”) or Greenlandic kablunâk (“white person, Dane”) (now spelled qallunaaq), or a combination of the two.
